item.title: Changbaishan 6-Day Luxury Family Tour from ¥4,980 (≈$692) a Child: Skiing, Volcanic Hot Springs & Yanji by Vintage Tram
item.description:
Deal price: 6 days / 5 nights from ¥4,980 per child (≈$692, was ¥5,980, early-bird ¥1,000 off) · Adults from ¥6,980 (≈$969) · Winter-season departures from Changchun · Book at least 3 days ahead, then confirm with customer service before buying your flights

This is the new luxury Changbaishan tour for the 2026–27 winter season, and it went on sale this morning (November 18). The pitch is “here, not Switzerland”: a night in a Swiss-style resort village at the foot of Changbaishan, family skiing at the quieter Huamei resort, two nights at a hot-spring hotel inside the Heaven Lake scenic area, and a finish in Yanji — the Korean-border city — by vintage tram. Five nights, all in international-brand hotels, with a family tour leader, a study guide and a photographer travelling with the group.

item.title: Inner Mongolia Keshiketeng Winter Pasture Family Tour from ¥3,680 (≈$511) a Child: 6 Days / 5 Nights, Winter Fishing, Rime Rafting & Off-Road Snow Crossing
item.description:
Deal price: 6 days / 5 nights from ¥3,680 per child (≈$511, was ¥4,680, early-bird ¥1,000 off) · Adults from ¥4,280 (≈$594) · Departures Dec 19, 2026 – Feb 18, 2027 · Confirm with customer service after booking

A different route from the Chongli/Ulan Butong snow tour also on this site: this one stays out on the Keshiketeng grasslands, built around the Mongolian winter pasture. Six days from Beijing to Chengde and deep into Inner Mongolia — winter fishing on Dalinor Lake, rafting down a rime-lined river, a night in a snow village, and a hard-core off-road crossing of the Greater Khingan snow forest in a Toyota Prado. The pace is slow by design, with a family tour leader, a photographer and a 1-to-5 ski coach travelling with the group.

item.title: Longjia Hotel Private Hot-Spring Room, Zhangzhou — from ¥428 (≈$59) a Night, was ¥668
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥428 (≈$59) a night (was ¥668) · Private hot-spring room + breakfast for two + 2 hot-spring passes · Valid Nov 4, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027 · Book at least a day ahead · Unused vouchers are refundable

Longjia Hotel （漳州龙佳大酒店） sits in its own eco hot-spring villa in Jiaomei — the town Xiamen locals call the city’s “back garden” — about 40 minutes out on Metro Line 6. The deal is a room with its own private soaking pool: you get the room, breakfast for two, and two passes to the hotel’s hot-spring pools, so you can soak in your room and then again in the shared springs. It’s an old, established hot-spring hotel rather than a new resort, and the reviews read like a regulars’ favourite.

item.title: Pan Pacific Haitianlou All-You-Can-Eat Dim Sum, Xiamen — ¥128 (≈$18) for 1 Adult + 1 Child, was ¥188
item.description:
Deal price: ¥128 (≈$18) for 1 adult + 1 child (was ¥188) · 2 adults + 1 child ¥236 (was ¥396) · Lunch or dinner, weekdays and weekends, no top-up · Valid Oct 23, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · Book by 19:00 the day before · Unused vouchers are refundable

Haitianlou （海天楼） is the Cantonese restaurant on the 4th floor of the Pan Pacific Xiamen, and this is its all-you-can-eat dim sum deal: not a buffet line but order-as-you-like — shrimp dumplings, xiao long bao, lava buns, cheung fun, fresh shrimp spring rolls, mochi, durian puffs, ginger chicken and the rest of the trolley, brought to the table as you order. Lunch runs 11:30–14:30 and dinner 17:30–21:30, every day of the week, and the price is the same on weekends — no top-up. With 259 reviews in the hotel’s pool on the platform, it is one of the best-reviewed dim sum deals in Xiamen.

item.title: Shankouling Village Resort near Hefei — from ¥369 (≈$51) a Night incl. Breakfast, Noodles & Afternoon Tea, was ¥1,388
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥369 (≈$51) a night (was ¥1,388) · Boutique room + breakfast + 2 handmade-noodle meals + afternoon tea for two + White Horse Mountain hike · Valid Nov 4 – Dec 31, 2026 · Book by 20:00 on the day · Unused vouchers are refundable

Shankouling （山口凌度假村） is a boutique stay in a century-old village about an hour from central Hefei — the village locals call a “little Jingdezhen” for its old kilns and craft shops. The deal is an all-in-one slow day out: a night in a light-luxury country room, breakfast, two bowls of handmade noodles at the village noodle shop, afternoon tea for two at the village bookshop, a hike up White Horse Mountain (walking sticks provided), camping on the village green, and the village art museum. No top-ups inside the validity period.

item.title: Beixi Tangjing Hot Spring Lodge, Zhangzhou — 1 Night + Campsite BBQ from ¥499 (≈$69), was ¥888
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids + outdoor hot-spring park + campsite BBQ for two — ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥888, about 44% off) · Private-spring room ¥599 (was ¥988) · Valid Sep 3 – Dec 30, 2026 · Weekends with no top-up · Book by 23:59 the day before · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Beixi Tangjing Hot Spring Lodge （北溪·汤境温泉宿集） is a soak-stay-and-eat combo in the hills outside Zhangzhou: a hot-spring park plus lodging in one, so the whole weekend happens without moving the car. The park has 17 outdoor pools and 3 indoor pools fed by metasilicic-acid spring water (≥25 mg/L), plus a forest outdoor pool that stays open through autumn and winter. Then, as evening comes, the campsite BBQ takes over — a two-person set (worth ¥178) with Angus beef cuts, wagyu, Austrian black pork and vegetables, grilled at your own pitch in the woods with background music drifting through the trees.

item.title: Riyuegu Hot Spring 4-Visit Card, Xiamen — ¥399 (≈$55) for 4 Visits, was ¥1,072
item.description:
Deal price: 4 hot-spring visits + 4 Kids’ Fun Palace entries — ¥399 (≈$55, was ¥1,072, about 63% off) · Valid Nov 10 – Dec 31, 2026 · Use all 4 at once or split them across visits · Unused vouchers are refundable

Riyuegu Hot Spring Resort （日月谷温泉渡假村） is Xiamen’s old favourite — a 20-plus-year-old resort village that regulars describe as a slice of Bali tucked into the hills of Haicang. This card covers 4 visits: each visit is one adult weekday hot-spring ticket plus one Kids’ Fun Palace ticket, and each visit can bring one child under 1.2 m free. Use all four in one family day out, or spread them across the season — the ticket and the Fun Palace entry can’t be split from each other, but the four visits are independent.

item.title: Shennongjia Snow Family Tour from ¥3,380 (≈$473) per Child — 6 Days / 5 Nights, Full-Day Skiing, Golden Monkeys & Three Gorges Dam
item.description:
Deal price: 6 days / 5 nights from ¥3,380 per child (≈$473, early-bird ¥1,000 off, was ¥4,380) · Adults from ¥4,380 (≈$613) · Departures Jan 24 – Feb 22, 2027 (10 departures, including Spring Festival departures Feb 6–11 and Feb 7–12) · Contact customer service after booking to confirm

Shennongjia is the quiet alternative to the big-name ski resorts. The pitch on the live page is blunt: Xinjiang and Changbai Mountain are crowded this winter, Shennongjia is not — and it is much closer to central China, reachable by high-speed rail or flight via Yichang. The ski field sits on the “Roof of Central China” at over 3,000 metres: a 100-plus-day snow season, soft powder the page compares to the Alps, and 15 runs from beginner slopes to wild-snow areas, so the whole family finds a run at its own level.

item.title: Shunde Changlu Holiday Park Family Ticket — ¥99 (≈$14) for 3 Days, was ¥350
item.description:
Deal price: family ticket for 3 days — ¥99 (≈$14, was ¥350, about 72% off) · Valid Nov 9, 2026 – Feb 28, 2027 · One ticket, free upgrade to a 3-day ticket · Book by 23:00 the day before · Unused vouchers are refundable

Changlu Holiday Park （顺德长鹿旅游休博园） in Shunde, Foshan is the kind of park where one day is genuinely not enough — which is why this ticket is good for three days. One ¥99 ticket covers a whole family group — 2 adults + 2 kids, or 2 adults + 2 seniors, or 3 adults — and packs in entry, the Fairy Tale Animal Kingdom, the land-sea-air theatre, 3 rides of your choice from 12, ¥100 of amusement credit and ¥20 of animal-feeding credit, plus vouchers for the Earth Village magic show (2 adult + 2 child) and the ice-snow world (4 × ¥75), and four viewing tickets for Changlu Farm.

item.title: Tangcheng Yupin Hot Spring Hotel, Yongchun — 1 Night with Private Balcony Pool from ¥428 (≈$59), was ¥738
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night in a hot-spring room + breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids + unlimited hot-spring park — ¥428 (≈$59, was ¥738, about 42% off) · Valid Sep 23 – Dec 31, 2026 · Book by 23:59 the day before · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Tangcheng Yupin Hot Spring Hotel （永春汤城御品温泉酒店） is the “little Bali” an hour or so from Xiamen — a hot-spring resort in Yongchun, Quanzhou where the spring water is piped into the rooms themselves. Every room in this deal comes with its own balcony hot-spring pool, so you can soak in private while looking out over the hills, then head down to the hot-spring park with 20+ garden pools — flower-petal pools, a mahjong pool, private nooks — as many times as you like during your stay. There is also an infinity pool, a spa area that the hotel pitches as the cure for a stiff office back, and a kids’ water park that takes over in the afternoons.

item.title: Tong'an Jinsuiyuan Hot Spring, Xiamen — ¥58 (≈$8) a Person, was ¥196
item.description:
Deal price: ¥58 (≈$8) a person (was ¥196, about 70% off) · Double ticket ¥110 (was ¥392) · Valid Jan 1 – Dec 31, 2026, any day of the week · Buy and use the same day · Unused vouchers are refundable

Jinsuiyuan Hot Spring （同安金穗园温泉） is a 4A-standard hot-spring park in Tong’an, Xiamen — about 25 acres of gardens, pavilions and winding paths hiding 50+ wellness pools, a national-standard indoor hot-spring pool, a large spa area and a Jurassic-themed hot-spring water park for kids. The water is the draw here: a rare silicate spring drawn from 158 m underground, coming out at 65°C, famously silky on the skin — the old line about it is “spring water so smooth it washes away the dust.”

item.title: Beijing Minmetals Junlan Hotel — 1 Night from ¥659 (≈$91), was ¥1,588, with Phoenix Ridge Tickets & Super Wings Play
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfast for two + noodle set for two + 2 Phoenix Ridge tickets — ¥659 (≈$91, was ¥1,588, about 58% off) · Valid Nov 13, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · No weekend top-up · Book by 23:59 the day before · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Beijing Minmetals Junlan Hotel （北京五矿君澜酒店） sits at the foot of the Western Hills in Haidian, right by Phoenix Ridge — a proper family hotel where the kids’ club is the main event, not an afterthought. The Lan Jingling Tribe runs bookable parent-child activities (think old-school games: spinning tops, shuttlecock, hoop rolling) plus a free kids’ play centre, and the hotel’s own Super Wings experience hall is a near-1,000㎡, three-storey play space with an 11-metre ceiling, a giant slide, a ball pit and climbing challenges. There is also a sci-fi Cloud Illusion exploration park with a C919 flight simulator and a Shenzhou spacecraft mock-up, a 25-metre indoor pool with a warm kids’ pool, a gym, table tennis and a chess room.

item.title: Fufeng Dijian Nanshan Hot Spring Hotel, Baoji — 5 Nights from ¥999 (≈$138), was ¥1,790, with 10 Hot-Spring Entries
item.description:
Deal price: 5 nights (splittable) + 10 breakfasts + 10 hot-spring entries + 2 camping spots — ¥999 (≈$138, was ¥1,790, about 44% off) · Valid Jul 20 – Dec 31, 2026 · Book by 23:59 the day before · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Fufeng Dijian Nanshan Hot Spring Hotel （扶风地建南山温泉酒店） is a slow-travel, soak-and-stay deal in Baoji, Shaanxi — about 1.1 km from the 5A-rated Famen Temple, home of the famous finger-bone relic of the Buddha. The package covers 5 nights at either of two sister hotels (the Fufeng Dijian Nanshan Hot Spring Hotel by the Famen cultural scenic area, or the Dijian Nanshan Qianhe Hotel), and the nights can be split however you like within the validity period: 1 room for 5 nights, 5 rooms for 1 night, or any combination in between.

item.title: Nanjing Yihe Jiezi Garden Hotel — 5 Nights from ¥2,240 (≈$309), was ¥3,200, Inside Laomendong
item.description:
Deal price: 5 nights in a 30–41㎡ Yayun room — ¥2,240 (≈$309, was ¥3,200, 30% off) · Valid Aug 31 – Dec 30, 2026 · Fri–Sat no top-up · Book by 17:00 the day before · Nights can be split · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Nanjing Yihe Jiezi Garden Hotel （南京颐和芥子园酒店） is a garden hotel with a real history: it stands on the site of the Jiezi Garden built 300 years ago by Li Yu, the Ming–Qing scholar who wrote The Mustard Seed Garden Manual of Painting — the classic Chinese painting textbook. The Yihe group restored the garden as a museum-style hotel, so you sleep inside a Ming–Qing garden of pavilions, rockeries and winding stone paths, right in the Laomendong scenic area — and the garden itself is open to the public by day but reserved for guests in the early morning and evening.

item.title: Qingdao Silver Beach Wyndham Supreme Hotel — 1 Night from ¥549 (≈$76), was ¥1,298, with Dinner Buffet & No Holiday Top-Up
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night in a 40㎡ sea-view room + breakfast for two + dinner buffet or Chinese set for two — ¥549 (≈$76, was ¥1,298, about 58% off) · Valid Oct 20, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · New Year’s Eve, New Year & Spring Festival — no top-up · Book by 18:00 on the day · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Qingdao Silver Beach Wyndham Supreme Hotel （青岛银沙滩温德姆至尊酒店） is a seaside stay where the beach is genuinely part of the hotel: a VIP walkway gets you to Silver Beach in 2 minutes, Golden Beach is a 5-minute drive, and Tangdaowan Park is across the street. Every room has a private balcony — the 40㎡ sea-view rooms look out over the bay — and the hotel was designed with ocean touches throughout, from the high-ceilinged lobby to the in-house Bavarian-style beer house.

item.title: Shanghai Yaoxue Crowne Plaza — 1 Night from ¥999 (≈$138), was ¥2,098, with Snow-Play Tickets & Lunch Buffet
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfast for two + snow-play tickets for 2 adults + 1 child + lunch buffet for 2 adults + 1 child — ¥999 (≈$138, was ¥2,098, about 52% off) · Snow-play tier valid Nov 7, 2026 – Feb 28, 2027 · Book by 23:59 the day before · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Shanghai Yaoxue Crowne Plaza （上海冰雪世界皇冠假日酒店） is the official hotel of Yaoxue Ice & Snow World — walk through Xingyao Plaza and you are at the snow park. The park is a 98,000㎡ indoor snow world kept at −3°C to −5°C all year, with a real-snow ski slope and a Nordic-themed snow-play zone of 10+ activities: the Snow Country Train, ice-cave exploring, snow climbing, speed sledding, ice bikes, snow-house building and more. The hotel itself leans into the theme — 370 rooms with ski and snow-mountain details (even the tissue box is shaped like a snow cabin), a spiral staircase that has become a photo spot, and a 24-hour gym.

item.title: Beijing Hyatt Place Shiyuan — 1 Night from ¥699 (≈$96), was ¥1,938, with Ice-Snow Carnival Picks
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night with breakfast + any 3 of 6 activities — ¥699 (≈$96, was ¥1,938, about 64% off) · Valid Nov 13, 2026 – Mar 30, 2027 · No weekend top-up · Book by 23:59 the day before · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Beijing Hyatt Place Shiyuan （北京世园凯悦酒店） sits right across the road from the Beijing Expo Park in Yanqing — the capital’s “back garden” of mountains, gorges and wetlands, home to the 2019 World Horticultural Expo and the 2022 Winter Olympics. The hotel’s 283 rooms (from about 40㎡) look out over the Expo gardens, and the whole stay is built around indoor play: in winter you never have to brave the cold to get from one activity to the next.

item.title: Chengdu 5-Day Family Tour — Pandas, Sanxingdui & a Palace Feast, Child from ¥4,180 (≈$577)
item.description:
Deal price: 5 days, 4 nights — child ¥4,180 (≈$577, was ¥4,980, about 16% off) · Adults ¥4,980 (≈$687) · Departures Dec 24, 2026 – Feb 20, 2027 (incl. Christmas & New Year departures) · Book at least 2 days ahead · Group needs 15 families to run (max 25)

Chengdu in 5 days, done properly. This winter family tour runs from the mystery of Sanxingdui to the giant pandas, from the Three Kingdoms stories of Wuhou Shrine to Du Fu’s thatched cottage, and from the 2,000-year-old Dujiangyan irrigation works to a night walk down Chunxi Road. The centrepiece is a 100-minute palace dinner show, the Jingong Liyan — six acts and ten performances while you eat, a living museum of Shu culture on the plate (a Shugong Banquet may substitute depending on the date).

item.title: Wuyi Huanglong Hot Spring Hotel — 1 Night from ¥399 (≈$55), was ¥584, in China's Hot Spring Town
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night in a 47–58㎡ room — ¥399 (≈$55, was ¥584, about 32% off) · 2 nights from ¥748 (≈$103) · Valid Sep 22 – Nov 30, 2026 · Weekends: no top-up · Book by 12:00 on the day · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Wuyi Huanglong Hot Spring Hotel （武义温泉黄龙饭店） opened at the end of 2025 in Wuyi Hot Spring Town — a county certified by China’s Ministry of Land and Resources as a “Hot Spring Town,” set on volcanic rock. The hotel is run by the Huanglong Hotel Management Group (the same group behind Hangzhou’s landmark Huanglong Hotel, founded 1988), and it shows: a French-style resort manor with crystal chandeliers, Roman columns and fountains, and rooms dressed in a quiet “fluorite green.” The 47–58㎡ Senyue rooms (1.8 m king or two 1.35 m twins) come with a small balcony, and the whole property sits a 3-minute walk from the Wuyi Hot Spring Fluorite Museum.

item.title: Xiamen Fantawild Holiday Hotel — 1 Night + 2-Day Park Tickets for 2, from ¥899 (≈$124)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + 2-day unlimited park tickets for 2 — from ¥899 (≈$124, was ¥1,399) · Both-parks tier ¥999 (≈$138, valid through Nov 30) · Valid Nov 14 – Dec 30, 2026 · Refundable before you reserve; auto-refund if it expires unused

A turnkey theme-park weekend on Zhongzhou Island, Tong’an (No. 1111 Shixun South Road): the Xiamen Fantawild Holiday Hotel, built by the Huaqiang Fantawild group beside its own theme-park resort, bundles 1 night with breakfast and 2-day park tickets with unlimited re-entry during your stay. The hotel itself covers nearly 40,000 m² in a new-Chinese style, with 365 rooms — every one with a private viewing balcony, custom pillows and bedding, and bathrooms with both a separate shower and a bathtub — plus Boonie Bears theming in the lobby, a garden restaurant (Minnan and Western breakfast), an outdoor pool, a gym and a kids’ playground. The two parks split the work: Dream Kingdom is the thrill-and-fairytale side (the heart-shaped “Eye of the Storm” coaster with 720° spins, a giant pendulum, pirate ship, Magic Castle, the Fly Over the Horizon simulator, a double-decker carousel), while Oriental Heritage runs on Chinese mythology — the Jungle Dragon coaster, Shenzhou Tower, and immersive motion rides like Nezha Stirs the Sea and Nuwa Mends the Sky. A shuttle train/cart runs between hotel and parks.

item.title: Xiamen Shengzhixiang Hot Spring Resort — 1 Night + Hot Springs for 2 Adults + 1 Child from ¥588 (≈$81), was ¥1,699
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + hot springs for 2 adults + 1 child — ¥588 (≈$81, was ¥1,699, about 65% off) · 2 nights from ¥799 (≈$110) · Valid Aug 15 – Dec 30, 2026 · Usable right after purchase · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Shengzhixiang Hot Spring Resort （厦门盛之乡温泉渡假村） spreads over 210,000㎡ in Tingxi Town, Tong’an — Xiamen’s “ecological town,” tucked into forested hills far from the city noise. The draw is the water itself: natural bicarbonate springs from deep under Tingxi, nicknamed “beauty soup,” feeding a cave hot spring that stays a constant temperature all year, plus an open-air spring park of overflowing pools set among the trees, a wooden boardwalk up the hill, and free tea at the poolside.

item.title: Harbin–Snow Town–Jilin–Changchun 6-Day Family Tour from ¥4,480 (≈$627) per Child, was ¥5,480
item.description:
Deal price: 6 days / 5 nights from ¥4,480 per child (≈$627, was ¥5,480, early-bird ¥1,000 off) · Adults from ¥5,980 (≈$836) · Departures Jan 20 – Feb 2, 2027 · Book at least 3 days ahead · Confirm with customer service after booking

This is a four-city loop through the Northeast’s ice season — Harbin, Snow Town, Jilin and Changchun — drawn as one route with no backtracking, so every day lands somewhere new. The headline stay is night one in Harbin’s Aoluguya Hyatt Centric, a forest-culture luxury hotel themed on the Ewenki reindeer tribe, about 10 minutes from the Ice and Snow World — the detail page notes it is the only hotel of its kind in China and that peak-season rooms there pass ¥2,000 a night. The Snow Town night is inside the scenic area itself at a 4-diamond hotel, a step up from the hard kang beds the town is notorious for: proper beds, private bathroom and heating, a 3-minute walk to Snow Rhythm Street.

item.title: Qingdao Shican Hotel, Curio Collection by Hilton — 1 Night from ¥559 (≈$78), was ¥1,298
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night in a deluxe room — ¥559 (≈$78, was ¥1,298, about 57% off) · Valid Nov 6 – Dec 31, 2026 · No weekend top-up · Book by 18:00 on the day · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Qingdao Shican Hotel, Curio Collection by Hilton （青岛石灿酒店希尔顿格芮精选） opened in July 2025 on the site of a former quarry, and the quarry is the design: a 60-metre vertical rock face is kept as a monument, the facade and courtyards use raw local stone, and the name itself comes from a line of the Chu Ci about rocks and sunset light. It sits in the Sino-German Ecopark on Qingdao’s West Coast, backed by Longdou Mountain and looking over Jiaozhou Bay — about 30 km from Golden Beach, the Qingdao Wildlife Park and Fantawild Dream Kingdom, and 1 km from Metro Line 6.

item.title: Shili Fangfei 6-City Hotel Pass — 1 Night from ¥899 (≈$126), was ¥1,198
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night at any of 6 resorts — ¥899 (≈$126, was ¥1,198, about 25% off) · Valid Sep 10, 2026 – Mar 30, 2027 · Book by 17:00 the day before · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Shili Fangfei （十里芳菲） is a chain of six garden-village resorts, and this pass lets you pick any one of them for a night — or split a longer pass across different resorts on different dates. The six are Hangzhou Xixi (inside the Xixi Wetland), Huzhou (a herb-fragrance village), Ji’an (an ancient village in Jiangxi), Ya’an (a wild-rose hot-spring village — the winter pick), Shigatse in Tibet (an oxygen-supplied healing hotel) and Huaying (a mountain village in Sichuan). Every stay includes daily breakfast for two, a minibar on the first day, and a local experience at the resort you choose — a hanfu photo session and wetland boat ride in Hangzhou, a herbal-bath craft and temple walk in Huzhou, a village lantern ceremony in Ji’an, a stream hike and campfire film night in Ya’an, a scripture-copying set in Shigatse, or a private hot-spring soak in Huaying.

item.title: Xiamen Jingmin Centre Hotel — 1 Night from ¥569 (≈$80), was ¥1,299
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night in a deluxe room — ¥569 (≈$80, was ¥1,299, about 56% off) · Valid Nov 11, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · No top-up on weekends or New Year’s Day · Book by 23:59 the day before · Unbooked vouchers are refundable, and expired ones refund automatically

Xiamen Jingmin Centre Hotel （厦门京闽中心酒店） is a 29-year-old hotel in the old city centre’s Songbai neighbourhood, 5 minutes by car from SM City Plaza — the practical choice for a family that wants to be in the middle of Xiamen rather than out by the beach. The ¥569 package covers 1 night in a deluxe king or twin room with a buffet breakfast for 2 adults + 2 children under 1.2 m, plus free use of the indoor swimming pool, gym and kids’ play area, free Wi-Fi and parking, and a welcome gift. Book a Friday-to-Sunday stay and the deal doubles up: a free upgrade to a family room (a 1.6 m double bed plus a 1.1 m single bed, with cartoon-themed bedding) and one child’s breakfast height limit raised to 1.4 m.

item.title: Yichun & Lesser Khingan Mountains 6-Day Snow Family Tour from ¥3,880 (≈$543) per Child, was ¥4,880
item.description:
Deal price: 6 days / 5 nights from ¥3,880 per child (≈$543, was ¥4,880, early-bird ¥1,000 off) · Adults from ¥4,580 (≈$641) · Departures Jan 21 – Feb 18, 2027 (10 departures) · Unused vouchers are refundable · Confirm with customer service after booking

This one is built around a single idea: skip the queues. Instead of the crowded Harbin–Snow Town circuit, it anchors in Yichun, in the Lesser Khingan Mountains — the snow forest from the Chinese primary-school textbook chapter The Beautiful Lesser Khingan Mountains — and keeps the group in the forest for four days. The pitch is that the snow is just as deep, the forest is quieter, and nothing on the itinerary involves standing in line. Harbin still bookends the trip (nights one and five at the Harbin International Convention Centre Hilton, opened July 2025), with free time at the start and end for Central Street, St Sophia Cathedral and the Ice and Snow World — which is running a Disney collaboration this winter, and whose ticket is not included.

item.title: Guangzhou Dongfang Xiawanna Hot Spring Hotel — 1 Night for 2 Adults + 1 Child from ¥299 (≈$42), was ¥888
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night for 2 adults + 1 child — ¥299 (≈$42, was ¥888, about 66% off) · Valid Nov 13 – Dec 31, 2026 · No weekend top-up · Book by 17:00 on the day

Dongfang Xiawanna Hotel （广州东方夏湾拿酒店） sits in Conghua — Guangzhou’s green backyard, about an hour from the city centre and reachable on Metro Line 14 — styled as a “Little Cuba” villa town on the Liuxi River. The draw is the hot-spring side: guests get unlimited access to the health-soak pools and the dry sauna during their stay, plus a swimming pool, gym, free 1-hour bike rides along the greenway, free 1-hour mahjong, free parking and Wi-Fi.

item.title: Shanghai Extreme JUMP Trampoline Park — All-Day Play from ¥69 (≈$10), was ¥99
item.description:
Deal price: all-day play, 1 person — ¥69 (≈$10, was ¥99, about 30% off) · Valid Nov 9 – Dec 31, 2026 · Buy and use immediately

Extreme JUMP （极限JUMP蹦床馆） is a 3,000㎡ three-floor indoor trampoline park in Kangqiao, Pudong — part trampoline park, part indoor playground, part de-stress zone. One ticket covers all-day unlimited play across dozens of activities: free trampolines, the signature 90° devil slide, an 8-metre jump platform, the sticky spider wall, trampoline basketball, a climbing zone, a big slide, plus VR, racing games, table tennis, baseball and a brain-teaser challenge course. It works for both kids and adults — and on a rainy or freezing day, it is entirely indoors.
